The '''Homestead Act''' was a law on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] [[Ariq Joanson]] spent months filling out forms to make use of the Homestead Act so that he could receive a land grant. When he received his land, Joanson built a [[Ariq Joanson's homestead|homestead]] and [[Moisture farm/Legends|moisture farm]].<ref name="Drawing the Maps of Peace: The Moisture Farmer's Tale">{{StoryCite|story=Drawing the Maps of Peace: The Moisture Farmer's Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref>
